clipboardImagesDescription: Embed original images so copied items can be pasted into another project or shared. Turn off for references within this project only.
generalDescription: Choose your workspace language and clipboard behavior.
shortcutsDescription: Edit actual application shortcuts. Changes are saved on this device.
editorDescription: Adjust the way objects respond while you work.
languageDescription: Menus, tools and messages use your selected language.
themeDescription: Follow your device or choose a light or dark workspace.
snapDescription: Align moving and resized objects to other elements and their artboard.
snapDistanceDescription: Measured in screen pixels so the attraction feels consistent at any zoom.
tryDescription: Drag the object near the reference. Hold Alt to bypass snapping; arrow keys move it, and Shift increases the step.
showCanvasZoomDescription: Display zoom buttons and the zoom percentage on the canvas.
